title: Region-Stamped Erasure Pipeline and RTBF Certificate Service
creator: Priya Shah
description: Problem: Customers operating across multiple legal jurisdictions require provable, region-aware erasure of PII that can be independently verified for audits. Current deletion flows are region-agnostic and produce logs that are hard to map to a single jurisdiction's evidence requirements. We need a pipeline that orchestrates deletion actions by residency, produces cryptographically verifiable certificates for each purge event, and exposes exportable evidence bundles to the customer control plane and compliance teams.
background: Motivation stems from enterprise customers in EU and APAC requesting: (1) per-region proof of erasure, (2) tamper-evident deletion receipts, and (3) automated reporting for auditors. Existing work items on geozone erasure orchestration and deletion exporters are fragmented; this ticket consolidates requirements into an end-to-end product deliverable: a region-stamped erasure pipeline and RTBF Certificate Service.
acceptance_criteria: API: Create /deletions POST that accepts residency hint and returns a deletion_id and expected completion ETA
Orchestration: Deletions are replayed to the correct regional data plane, respecting tenant retention settings and legal residency constraints

Evidence: For every completed deletion, a signed RTBF certificate (JSON) is generated with region_stamp, deletion_id, affected_objects, timeline, and a cryptographic signature verifiable via our public key endpoint
Export: Customers can download an evidence bundle (.zip) from the Console or request via API; bundle contains certificates, archival logs, and corresponding request traces
Audit trail: All deletion steps are logged to the audit store with immutable sequence IDs and are queryable by deletion_id
Compliance: Security review completed and design approved by Legal for EU/UK/SG PHIA scenarios
Monitoring: Dashboard shows deletion latency by region and a 95th percentile SLO of 30s for metadata-only deletions in Dedicated mode
End-to-end test: Automated test harness runs simulated RTBF requests against a staging private deployment and validates certificate signatures and bundle completeness

ENG: Implement deletion orchestration that routes to region-specific workers and uses region_stamp in messages (ENG-21234)
ENG: Build RTBF Certificate Service that signs certificates and exposes /certs/public-key
ENG: Add export endpoint and background worker to assemble evidence bundles
ENG: Integrate with KMS/HSM for signing keys and key rotation policy
SRE: Instrument metrics and traces for deletion pipeline; add dashboard panels
QA: Create end-to-end tests and a synthetic workload for retention-edge cases
Docs: How-to for customers to verify certificates and request bundles via API
risks_and_tradeoffs: Using a single global signing key simplifies verification but raises blast radius—hence require HSM-backed keys and rotation
Strong region enforcement adds routing complexity and potential availability trade-offs; fallback policies will be required for cross-region disaster recovery
Generating large evidence bundles for customers with heavy deletion volumes may increase storage and egress costs; we will introduce sampling and incremental export options
Real-time certificate generation increases latency for synchronous APIs; consider async issuance with webhook callbacks
notes_and_decisions: Decision 2026-01-18: Certificates will use ed25519 signatures and include a region_stamp and authoritative node id
Decision 2026-01-25: Deletion API will accept an optional residency_hint; if not supplied, system resolves residency via tenant metadata
Open: Need to finalize retention window semantics when deletion request is submitted during ongoing legal hold—Legal to advise
Implementation note: Use existing audit-ledger (ENG-20987) for immutable sequence IDs to avoid building a new store
